transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks for making the time, everyone. Quick round of intros before we dive in?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Sure. Priya here - I run operations for the US sites and I'm sponsoring the EU rollout.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Tom Becker, I manage EU operations out of Berlin.

transcript.speaker: speaker_04
transcript.text: Leo Park, solutions engineer on the Ghost Vendor side.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Great. Priya, what does success look like for the EU rollout?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Berlin and Rotterdam live on Relay before the January peak. What matters most to us is that the EU sites run the same workflows as the US sites.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Berlin has about 70 users and Rotterdam about 50, so roughly 120 seats.

transcript.speaker: speaker_04
transcript.text: That fits our multi-site setup. We can clone the US workflow templates and localise the carrier integrations.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: And on the commercial side, who else needs to be involved?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: The one thing I can't promise yet is budget. The EU line item has to be approved by finance in the Q3 planning cycle, and I don't control that.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Understood. Who in finance makes that call?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Finance decides as a committee; I'll take the proposal in myself.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Then I'll send a proposal for 120 seats by Friday so you have it for the planning cycle.
